scope: Additional source discovery and preview review only. No files from these leads were acquired or integrated.

leads.title: Shopping Bag
leads.creator: NoLagHere
leads.observation: Default rendered source view shows a teal bag with a red heart and surrounding yellow stars. It has thin pale loop handles and only a narrow visible top opening. The decoration is more gift-like and the cavity less clear than the selected 3dicons lead.
leads.access_check: Clicking Download 3D Model displayed Log in to Sketchfab. No credentials were entered and no access bypass was attempted.
leads.animation_status: Unknown; no source model acquired and no animation inspected. Generic viewer controls are not proof of clips.
leads.recommendation: Do not prioritize over the legally acquired plain open-bag source.
